prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
competitors_mentioned: The Corner Cottage in Green Hills
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with **The Corner Cottage in Green Hills**: it’s a single-level, two-bedroom home with a kitchen, laundry, screened porch, backyard, and two dedicated parking spaces. It’s a good fit if you want room to relax and don’t mind driving or taking rideshares to downtown. [View the Airbnb listing](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

If being closer to downtown matters more, look for a **two-bedroom place in Germantown or East Nashville**. Germantown is convenient for downtown and Nissan Stadium; East Nashville offers a more residential feel and neighborhood restaurants. A two-bedroom East Nashville cottage is among the options listed here: [Airbnb Nashville homes](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/houses).

Before booking, check your dates and total price, recent reviews, parking, sleeping arrangements, and whether the listing has a valid Nashville short-term-rental permit. I can’t verify availability or current prices without your travel dates. If you share your dates, budget, kids’ ages, and whether you’ll have a car, I can narrow down what to prioritize.
